title: Xabi Alonso on Emmanuel Emegha selection for Leeds clash | News | Official Site
text:
Xabi Alonso on Emmanuel Emegha selection for Leeds clash | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 Xabi Alonso believes Emmanuel Emegha is ready to take his opportunity against Leeds United, as the Dutch forward prepares to make his first start for the Blues. 
 Chelsea return to Stamford Bridge following the two-week international break, with Alonso determined to see his side get back to winning ways against Leeds.
 The forward made his Blues debut in our Carabao Cup clash against Liverpool and earned his first Premier League minutes against Sunderland before the international break, and now Alonso has included him from the off for the first time this afternoon. 
 Explaining his selection, Alonso said: 'We have seen a lot from him, but he needed to build his fitness because he had picked up a few injuries. Now he's been training for a long time, he's played some minutes, he's been patiently working hard and now he's got the chance to start.
 'And today, hopefully, he has a good game and he's feeling good.'
 With Emegha joined in attack by Cole Palmer , Morgan Rogers and Estevao Willian , Alonso is hoping to see plenty of creativity from his side. However, the Blues manager has stressed that maintaining the right balance between attack and defence will be crucial against Leeds.
 The boss continued: 'Our attacking players need to be ready to defend, ready to have this solidity that is needed in these kind of games.
 'But as well, we need creativity, we need to be a threat in the last third. With these players we can have it, but we need to play a complete game.'
